data.body: Live Bedrock capture recorded (docs/experiments/f6fc_live_memo_nudge.py + f6fc-live-memo-nudge.md). The live run surfaced two REAL defects the FunctionModel unit tests could not: (1) pydantic-ai COPIES a WrapperToolset per run step, so cache stored as instance attrs did not survive across turns -> moved cache/counts/locks to closure scope (mirrors the runaway guard). (2) pydantic-ai runs a turn's tool calls CONCURRENTLY, so a same-turn identical batch raced the cache -> added a per-signature asyncio.Lock around check-execute-store. Post-fix live run proves real executions=1 while guard-observed tool_calls=2 (1 duplicate served from cache) and the model emitted a final answer (nudge broke the loop). Added held-out concurrent-batch oracle test (teeth-verified). All 8 ACs met: 25 unit tests green (memo 9 + guard 16), seam test updated for the new guard->memo->steering nesting (38 green together), make lint + make typecheck clean, agent_call.py 361 LOC (< 800).
